ui.sidebarMobileDescription: Shows the sidebar on small screens.

remote.pairDescription: On your computer, open PP Agent › Settings › Phone access and press Pair a device. Then enter the code shown there, or scan its QR code with this device's camera.
remote.unreachableDescription: Check that the computer is on, PP Agent is running with phone access turned on, and this device is on the same Wi-Fi.
remote.offline: Can't reach the computer. Check that it is on and on the same network.
remote.desktopOnlyAction: This can only be done in PP Agent on the computer.
remote.onlyWebLinks: Only web links (http or https) can be opened.
